name: tasking
description: 基于 plan.md 与 test-plan.md 把工作拆为 tasks/task-NN.md，并生成 tasks/task-group.json 描述任务依赖与并行批次。task-group.json 必须位于 tasks/ 内部。

prompt.instruction: Read plan.md (decisions) and test-plan.md (acceptance). Produce a directory tasks/ with task-01.md, task-02.md, ... Each task must follow task_template.md and explicitly cite which test-plan groups (G1, G2, ...) it covers. Then produce tasks/task-group.json with fields { version, tasks[], parallelGroups? }. Every tasks[i] must have unique id 'task-NN', file 'task-NN.md', title, and dependsOn[] (array of existing ids). Optionally provide parallelGroups[] which is the authoritative batch schedule (overrides dependsOn-derived layering when present).
guardrails: task-group.json MUST be written to tasks/task-group.json — never to the run dir's top level.
Each task must declare 关联验收点 referencing test-plan group IDs.
dependsOn entries must be ids that actually exist in tasks[].
If parallelGroups is provided, every task id must appear in exactly one inner array.
Aim for tasks small enough to be reviewed in isolation; if a task touches more than ~5 files, consider splitting it.
